sloka: पुष्प वृष्टिः महती आसीत् देव दुंदुभि निस्वनैः ।गन्धर्व अप्सरसाम् च एव महान् आसीत् समुत्सवः ॥१-४९-१९॥
transliteration: puṣpa vṛṣṭiḥ mahatī āsīt deva duṁdubhi nisvanaiḥ ।gandharva apsarasām ca eva mahān āsīt samutsavaḥ ॥1-49-19॥

translations.english: Amidst sounds of celestial kettledrums, devatas showered flowers, gandharvas sang and apsarasa danced. There was a great assemblage (of divinities).
